evals.prompt: Create a test plan for a payment processing feature before implementation starts
evals.expected_output: A risk-based test plan covering unit, integration, and end-to-end layers, with edge cases (declined cards, timeouts, double submissions) and explicit quality gates before release.

evals.prompt: Our CI passes but production bugs keep slipping through. Review our quality gates
evals.expected_output: Identifies missing gates: coverage thresholds on changed files, integration tests against a real database, contract tests for external APIs, and a manual exploratory pass before release.

evals.prompt: What test coverage target should we set and why?
evals.expected_output: Recommends a meaningful threshold (for example 80 percent on business logic, not a vanity 100 percent), measures coverage on changed lines in CI, and treats uncovered branches in critical paths as the real signal.
